choices: The thing is established by God, and God will shortly bring it to pass
questions.explain: Seven kine and seven ears: seven years of plenty and seven of famine.

questions.q: To whom did Joseph give the praise for interpreting the dream?
choices: God: it is not in me
questions.explain: The secret of the Lord is with them that fear him (Psalm 25:14).

questions.q: What counsel did Joseph give Pharaoh?
choices: Store up the fifth part of the land in the plenteous years
questions.explain: A prudent man foreseeth the evil (Proverbs 22:3).

questions.q: Which of Joseph's sons received the greater blessing from Jacob?
questions.explain: Jacob set Ephraim before Manasseh (Genesis 48:17-20); Jeroboam, the first king of the north, was of Ephraim.

questions.q: What does it show that Pharaoh changed Joseph's name to Zaphnathpaaneah?
choices: The heathen like to change our names, as spiritual Egypt does today
Pharaoh adopted him as a son
questions.explain: That is one reason America is called spiritual Egypt.
